newspaper.headline: Report Card App Back to Normal
newspaper.lead: After fixes from the new developer, averages in the report card app are correct again. Today the team received more bug reports from users.

impact.good: Yesterday, Nusa Digital's new developer finished every task neatly. No bugs slipped through to users.
impact.mixed: Yesterday, most of the new developer's tasks were done, though some tests were still red. Dimas asked for more careful error reading.
impact.bad: Yesterday, several bugs still reached users. The developer team got many complaints and the task queue piled up.

tip.title: Tip: print() Is a Flashlight
tip.text: Not sure why the result is wrong? Print the variable inside the loop. It's like switching on a flashlight in a dark room.

newspaper.classified: WANTED: A rubber duck to talk to while debugging. Contact Dimas.
sources: Python Software Foundation: Errors and Exceptions
